desc: ELEVATE YOUR TACTICAL SET-UP with the Beretta A300 Ultima Patrol – engineered to be ultra-reliable and easy to manipulate. Featuring the classic mechanisms of the venerable A300 platform, this defense shotgun includes enlarged controls, an enhanced loading port, a thinner forend design with multiple M-Lok and QD sling mounting points, and an extended magazine tube secured by a custom barrel clamp with integral M-Lok capability.
